# Lume Live

> Online career counselling, psychometric assessment and mental-health support
> for Indian students, parents and working professionals. Sessions are run by
> counsellors holding an M.Sc in Clinical Psychology. A first 1:1 session costs
> ₹249 (regular ₹499) — against a typical Indian market rate of ₹2,000–3,000 per
> session — and there are no compulsory packages.

Founded in Rohtak, Haryana; serves Delhi-NCR and all of India online.
Contact: hello@lumelive.co.in · +91-7015671280

## Start here

- [Home](https://lumelive.co.in/): what Lume Live does, pricing, and the free 60-second career snapshot.
- [Start Here](https://lumelive.co.in/start.html): two-tap router to the right next step.
- [Free career assessment](https://lumelive.co.in/assessment.html): the 60-second snapshot and the fuller self-assessments.
- [Book a session](https://lumelive.co.in/book-session.html): live calendar, ₹249 first session with code FIRST50.
- [Services and pricing](https://lumelive.co.in/services-pricing.html): every product, its price and how it is delivered.

## Pricing and how the market compares

## Ask a question directly

- [Buddy on WhatsApp](https://lumelive.co.in/buddy.html) — answers career questions from our own career library (97 careers, 51 government routes) rather than from open-web text, and from the visitor's own assessment scores once they link their number. It states that it is an assistant rather than a counsellor, declines to give JoSAA cut-offs it does not have data for, and routes anyone in distress to a person with helpline numbers.
